# Math in Motion

**Math in Motion** is the student visualization initiative of Engineering Mathematics (25735).

Students transform selected mathematical ideas from the course into short visual explanations using Python and Manim.

> **Make mathematical structure visible.**

Each contribution connects:

- a mathematical concept;
- a visual representation;
- an explanation;
- reproducible source code.

## Technology

Python · Manim Community Edition · Quarto · GitHub Pages

## Student authorship

Every animation credits its student creators and links to its underlying source code. The gallery is curated for mathematical correctness, pedagogical clarity, and technical quality.
